text:
maria: FYI deploy-bot fired a rule during the 00:00 change window: release-notes reference a new config flag (`enable-hetero-routing`) but the released binary throws on unknown flags.

deploy-bot: Safety check triggered: release_notes_mismatch_binary_missing (id: RN-073). Recommended actions: (1) pause rollout, (2) rollback to previous stable, or (3) cut a hotfix tag.

ops-luke: Any customer errors yet?

maria: No external alerts. QA saw one instance where the process exited with `EINVALIDFLAG`. Could be config propagation.

ryan: If it's not customer-facing, my vote is hotfix (cut v4.2.1) rather than a full rollback. Less churn for metrics and dashboards.

legal-kat: Quick note: if release notes advertise config that customers may start setting, we need a support blurb ready. Also include a changelog footnote about the revert to avoid contract confusion.

support-jordan: I'll standby to compose the CSM message: "Pausing rollout for a minor release-note mismatch; no impact observed; patching now."

ops-luke: Operational tradeoffs: rollback to v4.2.0 takes ~12-18 mins and restores traffic immediately. Hotpatch will take ~40-60 mins (branch, reapply commit, build, smoke). Rollback simpler but we'd need to re-release the actual feature later.

maria: If we rollback, telemetry will be split across two releases which complicates recent experiments. Hotpatch keeps continuity.

deploy-bot: Current auto-rollback thresholds: error spike >1.8x baseline for 8m OR p95 latency +40% sustained for 10m. Current metrics: error rate stable, p95 +5%. No auto action.

ryan: Plan: pause rollout and pin traffic to v4.2.0 while we author a hotpatch tag v4.2.1. If anything degrades we immediately flip traffic back.

ops-luke: Running: `deployctl pause --release v4.2.0` (note: paused the v4.2.0 rollout). Pin: `deployctl traffic pin --to v4.2.0 --percent 100` — applied.

support-jordan: Internal note posted to #support-ops with draft CSM blurb.

maria: Starting hotpatch branch now. Will reapply the handler commit that was lost in the cherry-pick.

ryan: Add the original changelog commit and the revert link in the PR so legal can trace it.

legal-kat: Confirmed. Also requesting a short line in the release notes about "patched mismatch" for audit trail.

maria: Staging image built. Smoke: config parsing OK, no unknown flag errors. Basic functional tests pass.

ops-luke: Ready to promote when PR merged.

maria: Merged, tag pushed: v4.2.1. Launching staged rollout at 2% to be safe.

deploy-bot: Detected v4.2.1. Initiating staged rollout under policy "night-minimal-ramp". Monitoring error-rate, p95, and startup failures.

ryan: I'll watch dashboards. If anything exceeds thresholds, ops flip: `deployctl traffic set --release v4.2.1 --percent 0`.

support-jordan: Drafted external note ready in case CSMs need it.

deploy-bot: Rollout at 2% healthy -> 15% -> 40% (metrics stable).

maria: Promoting to 100% now.

deploy-bot: Rollout complete. No regressions in 25m post-deploy window. Marking v4.2.1 as stable.

ryan: Follow-up actions: add a preflight gate on changelog entries that introduce new flags (ticket RN-074), and add a small test ensuring binaries parse newly-documented flags during CI.

legal-kat: I'll keep the changelog footnote for compliance.

maria: Closing thread. Thanks all for quick coordination. :slightly_smiling_face:
